t1/anombyte93/prd-taskmaster.note: The install session registered its Claude Code plugin but not task-master-ai, which the README also lists, so the Auto-Execute mode was not on offer. The tool recommended its Verified Loop, wrote a PRD of 12 tasks and 24 subtasks for the page, and was still working at the 30-minute limit. The page it had by then sent the form as a page reload and recorded nothing (screenshots agree with the tester).
t1/anombyte93/prd-taskmaster.note_zh: 安装时只注册了它的 Claude Code 插件，没装 README 里也列出的 task-master-ai，所以「自动执行」模式没有出现。它推荐了自己的「验证循环」，为这个网页写了 12 个任务、24 个子任务的 PRD，30 分钟时还没做完；当时的页面点「记一笔」只会整页刷新，什么都记不下（截图与测试员一致）。

t1/gsd-build/get-shit-done.note: After its five questions it was still working at the 30-minute limit, with no closing message; the page in output/ by then passed every check.
t1/gsd-build/get-shit-done.note_zh: 问完 5 个问题后一直在走流程，30 分钟时还没结束、没有收尾消息；但那时 output/ 里的页面已通过全部检查。

t1/nurettincoban/ai-prd-workflow.note: Stopped four times: its interview, a plan to approve, a question whether to move from localStorage to IndexedDB after its own browser tests saw records go missing, and a second plan. Still working at the 30-minute limit; the page by then passed every check.
t1/nurettincoban/ai-prd-workflow.note_zh: 停下来 4 次：需求访谈、批准计划、自己的浏览器测试发现记录偶尔丢失后问要不要从 localStorage 改用 IndexedDB、批准第二份计划。30 分钟时还没结束，但那时的页面已通过全部检查。

t2/anombyte93/prd-taskmaster.note: Two questions, then its Verified Loop. At the 45-minute limit the page recorded entries and exported them, but its month overview read ¥0.00, the category panel held three empty placeholders and the budget panel said 等待实现 (still to be built). The Mac slept for about 90 minutes during this run; the build's limit counts working time only, so it is shown as 45 minutes, not the 137 the clock recorded.
t2/anombyte93/prd-taskmaster.note_zh: 问了 2 个问题，然后走它的「验证循环」。45 分钟上限时，页面能记账也能导出，但月度概览显示 ¥0.00，分类统计是三个空的占位框，预算面板写着「等待实现...」。这次运行中 Mac 睡眠了约 90 分钟；构建的上限只算工作时间，所以记为 45 分钟，而不是时钟记下的 137 分钟。

t2/nurettincoban/ai-prd-workflow.note: Its interview, then a plan of seven RFCs to approve one by one. At the 45-minute limit the ledger did everything but the budget and the export; its own help text points to backup buttons that are not on the page.
t2/nurettincoban/ai-prd-workflow.note_zh: 先是需求访谈，然后是 7 份 RFC，要逐份批准。45 分钟上限时，记账本除了预算和导出都能用；它自己的使用说明里提到的备份按钮页面上并没有。

t2/coleam00/context-engineering-intro.note: Built as a small project with a start script: there is no index.html to double-click, so a person has to run bash output/start.sh first.
t2/coleam00/context-engineering-intro.note_zh: 做成了一个要先启动的小项目：没有可以双击的 index.html，得先运行 bash output/start.sh。

t2/asklokesh/loki-mode.note: Run a second time: during the first, the Mac went to sleep, which cut its install session short and let the run's outer limit expire. That attempt is kept in out-void/ and not counted.
t2/asklokesh/loki-mode.note_zh: 这是第二次运行：第一次运行时 Mac 睡眠了，安装会话被截断，整次运行的外层时限也到了。那次留在 out-void/ 里，不计入结果。

t2/gsd-build/get-shit-done.note: After seven questions it built in phases. At 44 minutes it had finished its first phase (recording, a list by day, month switching, edit and delete) and stopped to ask for a manual check of it; with under a minute of the 45 left, the run ended there. Monthly totals, the category chart, the budget and the export had not been built (the tester's verdicts agree with the screenshots).
t2/gsd-build/get-shit-done.note_zh: 问了 7 个问题后分阶段做。到 44 分钟时做完了第一阶段（记账、按天列出、按月翻页、编辑删除），停下来请用户手动验收；45 分钟只剩不到一分钟，测试到此为止。月度汇总、分类图、预算和导出都还没做（测试员结论与截图一致）。

t1/coleam00/context-engineering-intro.note: Its own browser checks saw records lost on a local file, so it added a small local server (START.txt) and a banner on the page warning against opening it by double-click. That took most of its 29.7 minutes. The page opened by double-click still passed every check.
t1/coleam00/context-engineering-intro.note_zh: 它自己的浏览器检查发现直接打开本地文件时记录会丢，于是加了一个本地服务器（START.txt），并在页面顶部提示别用双击打开，29.7 分钟大多花在这上面。双击打开的页面仍通过了全部检查。
